Aero 1.2.3 works in your own signed-in browser with no setup, and fixes what a day of hands-on testing of 1.2.1 turned up.

## Install or update

Aero 1.0, 1.1 and 1.2 offer this update at startup (**Update now**). New installs:

| System | File | Then |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Windows** 10 / 11 (64-bit) | `Aero-windows.zip` | Extract it, double-click `Update-Aero.bat`, accept the admin prompt. `--dest D:\Aero` installs elsewhere; `--lean` skips setting up the integrations now (Aero finishes them in the background). |
| **macOS** (Apple Silicon or Intel) | `Aero-macos.zip` | Unzip it, right-click `Install-Aero.command` → Open. |
| **Linux**, any distro | `install.sh` | `curl -fsSL https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/releases/latest/download/install.sh \| sh` |
| Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS | `aero_1.2.3_all.deb` | `sudo apt install ./aero_1.2.3_all.deb` |
| Fedora, RHEL, Rocky, Alma, openSUSE | `aero-1.2.3-1.noarch.rpm` | `sudo dnf install ./aero-1.2.3-1.noarch.rpm` |
| Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS | `PKGBUILD` | `makepkg -si` |
| Any Linux, by hand | `Aero-linux.tar.gz` | `sh Aero/install.sh` |

Models, chats, memory, settings, keys, tunings, skills and mods carry over.

## What's new

- **Your own browser, no switch needed (Windows).** Aero opens a window of your default browser, in your everyday profile, so you're already signed in. It works in that window by sight: a picture with numbered controls.
  - Links and buttons are pressed, and fields are filled and read back, without using your mouse or keyboard.
  - Aero types only into the page. It never types into the address bar, the browser's menus or a password field.
  - Aero sees only the window it opened, and closes it when it's done. If you added tabs to it, the window stays open.
  - Tested on Chrome and Edge.
  - The remote-debugging switch from 1.2.1 still works, and is faster when it's on.
- **You can see what Aero is using.** The app or browser window a model is using gets a blue outline. A banner on top says "*model* is using *app*" and has a **Stop** button.
  - Both follow the window across monitors.
  - Aero's cursor no longer gets stuck on a side monitor.
- **Images next to a big model:** 16.7 s instead of 8 minutes. When the card is full, the main model steps aside for the image and comes back with the same settings.
- **The tuning advisor behaves.**
  - Advisors that can't load are deleted, not downloaded again.
  - There are no 27B advisors on the CPU.
  - Cancel stops it at once.
- **No false "it's open".** A missing app (Calculator removed from Windows) is reported as missing. After starting a program, the model checks that its window appeared.
- **Hindsight starts on every PC**, whatever the system's text encoding.
- **Smaller fixes:**
  - Skills say where their files are.
  - A skipped sign-in isn't asked again.
  - The workspace panel no longer shows the wrong workspace.
  - After an update the window loads the new interface.

Test report: [V1.2.1_HANDS_ON_TESTS.md](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/docs/V1.2.1_HANDS_ON_TESTS.md). Full list: [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/NermalYT/Aero/blob/main/source/CHANGELOG.md).
